seo_title: West Memphis Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in West Memphis, Arkansas for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: West Memphis does Christmas with a Broadway parade, a family party at the Devil Dome and a city tree lighting, and Santa arrives by plane at the municipal airport.
celebrates: The West Memphis Area Chamber of Commerce leads the season with its Christmas Parade, which it calls Caroling Down Broadway, with festive floats, marching bands, walking groups and performances from local businesses and organizations. The chamber broadcasts it live on Facebook and posts a recording on YouTube. A Best Memphis Christmas, the chamber's after party at the Devil Dome, adds a market, food trucks, bounce houses and pictures with Santa. The City of West Memphis holds a tree lighting at Worthington Park with carols, a petting zoo, ornament decorating, hot cocoa, train rides and a visit from Santa, and welcomes Santa by plane at its airport.
lastyear: The 73rd annual West Memphis Christmas Parade took place on Tuesday, December 2, 2025, at 7 pm. The chamber's event calendar said line-up began at 5 pm in the Meadow Brook Shopping Center parking lot, and parade entries paid a $35 fee. The chamber's Instagram post for the night said the parade began at Meadowbrook Shopping Center on West Broadway and ended at the West Memphis Christian Center on North Missouri Street.
facts: The 2026 parade is the 74th annual West Memphis Christmas Parade, according to the West Memphis Area Chamber of Commerce. The chamber says families from across the Mid-South gather for it. Last year the parade ran on a Tuesday night. This year it is on a Saturday morning at 10:30 am, with a party at the Devil Dome right after. The chamber also records the parade and posts it on YouTube for anyone who missed it.
trains: West Memphis does not have a Christmas train of its own on our list, but two Memphis rail attractions are close by. The Memphis Railroad & Trolley Museum fills a suite at Central Station on South Main Street and tells the story of Memphis railroads and trolleys. MATA Trolley runs vintage and replica streetcars downtown and has since 1993. The City of West Memphis has also offered train rides at its tree lighting at Worthington Park.

faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in West Memphis?

The biggest event is the West Memphis Christmas Parade, run by the West Memphis Area Chamber of Commerce. The chamber describes floats, marching bands, walking groups and performances from local businesses, and families come from across the Mid-South. A Best Memphis Christmas at the Devil Dome follows right after the parade.
Can kids meet Santa in West Memphis?

Yes, in more than one way. The chamber lists pictures with Santa at A Best Memphis Christmas at the Devil Dome, and the City of West Memphis invites families to watch Santa arrive by plane at the municipal airport. The city's tree lighting at Worthington Park has also included a visit from Santa.
Does West Memphis have a tree lighting?

Yes. The City of West Memphis holds an annual Christmas tree lighting at Worthington Park. The city's posts describe Christmas carols, a petting zoo, ornament decorating, hot cocoa, train rides and a special visit from Santa. Check the city's social pages for the date each year before you plan your evening.
Can I watch the West Memphis Christmas Parade online?

Yes. The chamber says it broadcasts the parade live on its Facebook page and posts a recording on YouTube. That helps if the weather is cold or the little ones cannot stand along Broadway for long. The chamber also suggests hosting a watch party with friends along the parade route.

The chamber calls the parade Caroling Down Broadway, so it runs along Broadway. Last year it began at Meadowbrook Shopping Center on West Broadway and ended at the West Memphis Christian Center on North Missouri Street. Check the chamber's pages for this year's route and for any changes before you go.
